name: Goal Bars
description: Daily bars in tubes against a goal tick, water when the goal is reached and paler water when not, with a week switcher.

props.name: data
props.description: One value per day. New data refills the tubes.

props.name: goal
props.description: The daily goal, marked with a short tick across each tube.

props.name: name
props.description: What is counted, for the tooltip and table.

props.name: color
props.description: Water colour of days that reach the goal. The others take a paler mix of it.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip and legend. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatAxis
props.description: Writes the tick labels on the left. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title, e.g. "Monday 29 Jun".

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a legend for reached, below and the goal.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header, such as a PeriodStepper from @/components/miyuki-ui/lib/chart for the week.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. "total steps".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts delta, note, footer and every other prop of a div.
